# Facebook advertising concepts

Rules for every ad: show real pages; label mockups as "digital mockup"; state "digital download – nothing shipped"; no fake reviews, ratings, awards, urgency timers or developmental promises.

## Concept A – "Rainy-day rescue"
- Visual: Product_Image_3 (Rainbow Rescue board + cards).
- Primary text: "Six clouds lost their colour! Print My Magic Busy Book at home and let your 3–5 year old match, sort and count with Leo the Little Explorer. 48 pages · 36 missions · US Letter + A4 PDFs."
- Headline: "36 little missions, one printable book"
- CTA: Shop now. Audience: parents of 3–5 year olds, interests in preschool learning and printables.

## Concept B – "Cut once, play again"
- Visual: 15 s version of Reel 1 (printer → scissors → envelope → play).
- Primary text: "One evening of grown-up prep, many quiet-time sessions. 97 large reusable cards on 5 sheets, plus 10 missions that need no cutting at all."
- Headline: "Printable busy book for ages 3–5"
- CTA: Learn more.

## Concept C – "Free mission first" (lead magnet)
- Visual: Rainbow Rescue page + "FREE SAMPLE" label.
- Primary text: "Try before you buy: download Mission 01 – Rainbow Rescue – free. If your little explorer loves it, the full book has 35 more."
- Headline: "Free printable colour-matching mission"
- CTA: Download. Landing page: email sign-up delivering Free_Sample_Activity.pdf.
